blocks.en: For future teams, synthetic biology projects, and laboratories, ReLEAF provides reproducible hardware including a hydroponics platform, bioreactor, LPA, and in-line photometer, supported by printable files and standardized dimensions. We also provide a plant-testing protocol, modular optogenetic parts, digital twin software, an LLM-assisted GIS workflow. For sustainability, we include reusable education resources and hay infusion protocol for making bacteria medium. For each contribution, we document what worked, what did not, and what we would improve next.

blocks.en: ReLEAF was designed as a modular genetic system, allowing individual components to be modified or replaced without rebuilding the entire construct. The system is organized into five functional modules: four make up the green-light-responsive circuit, while the fifth drives constitutive expression of the plant-protective cargo and was used to generate the experimental results shown on this wiki.

blocks.en: Supplies phycocyanobilin, the chromophore CcaS-m3 needs to sense light, by converting endogenous heme inside the cell. The promoter PtagC and a ribosome binding site control transcription and translation, followed by the ho1–pcyA fusion CDS, which encodes heme oxygenase 1 fused to phycocyanobilin:ferredoxin oxidoreductase. The terminator L3S2P21 closes the module.

blocks.en: 2. Light sensing the green-light photoreceptor, and the RBS chosen for Bacillus subtilis
blocks.text: 2. Light sensing the green-light photoreceptor, and the RBS chosen for Bacillus subtilis
blocks.zh: 2. 光感測 綠光光受體，以及為 Bacillus subtilis 選的 RBS

blocks.en: Contains the engineered green-light photoreceptor that detects external light. The constitutive promoters PlepA and PliaG give baseline transcription, and RBS0, a strong ribosome binding site optimized for B. subtilis, initiates translation. At its center is the ccaS-m3 CDS: once loaded with the PCB module 1 supplies, CcaS-m3 detects green light and autophosphorylates, relaying the signal downstream.

blocks.zh: 含有偵測外界光線的工程化綠光光受體。組成型啟動子 PlepA 與 PliaG 提供基礎轉錄，而為 B. subtilis 最佳化的強核醣體結合位 RBS0 啟動轉譯。核心是 ccaS-m3 CDS：一旦裝上模組 1 提供的 PCB，CcaS-m3 便偵測綠光並自磷酸化，把訊號往下游傳。

blocks.en: The largest module contains all three protectant cargoes behind a constitutive promoter with the shuttle vector that carried them into B. subtilis: eight constitutive cassettes on the Registry, with the eight secretion fusions and eight cargo sequences they are assembled from. A light-gated cassette cannot be tested until the cargo itself expresses and secretes, so this series was built first and every protein, plant and reactor result came out of it. For a future team it is the entry point: build the expression module, confirm the cargo, then put the light circuit in front of it.

blocks.zh: 最大的一個模組，把三種保護劑貨物全都放在組成型啟動子之後，並連同把它們帶進 B. subtilis 的穿梭載體：Registry 上八個組成型卡匣，以及組成它們的八個分泌融合序列與八個貨物序列。在貨物本身能表現並分泌之前，光控卡匣根本無從測起，所以這一系列是先建起來的，而所有蛋白質、植物與反應器的結果都出自它。對未來的隊伍，它就是入口：先建表現模組、確認貨物，再把光迴路接到它前面。

blocks.en: A standardized workflow for evaluating plant responses under controlled growth and stress conditions, so a protectant result can be attributed to the protectant.
blocks.text: A standardized workflow for evaluating plant responses under controlled growth and stress conditions, so a protectant result can be attributed to the protectant.
blocks.zh: 一套在受控生長與逆境條件下評估植物反應的標準化工作流程，好讓保護劑的結果真的能歸因於保護劑。

blocks.en: The protocol fixes temperature, photoperiod, nutrients, growth medium, plant age and hydroponic conditions on Arabidopsis thaliana, and adds controlled stress procedures for salinity, long-term heat and short-term heat shock. Each experiment records stress intensity, duration, plant age and treatment conditions, so it can be run again. The readouts are fixed too: root length, fresh weight, chlorophyll, MDA, anthocyanin, total protein and relative gene expression, with root length traced by hand in ImageJ from the baseline drawn on the plate. Leaf area stays qualitative, because leaves overlap and obstruct the measurement.

The readouts are fixed too: root length, fresh weight, chlorophyll, MDA, anthocyanin, total protein and relative gene expression, with root length traced by hand in ImageJ from the baseline drawn on the plate. blocks.zh: 這份流程把阿拉伯芥的溫度、光週期、養分、生長培養基、植株日齡與水耕條件固定下來，並加入鹽度、長期熱逆境與短期熱休克的受控逆境程序。每次實驗都記錄逆境強度、持續時間、植株日齡與處理條件，因此可以再跑一次。讀數也固定：根長、鮮重、葉綠素、MDA、花青素、總蛋白與相對基因表現量，其中根長是在 ImageJ 中以培養盤上畫的基準線手動描出來的。葉面積維持定性描述，因為葉片彼此重疊會擋住量測。

blocks.en: Experimental logic. Salt only measures the effect of salinity stress. Protectant only measures whether the protectant itself affects growth. Salt plus protectant measures whether it rescues. Pre against co against post measures when delivery is most effective.

blocks.en: A microscale DNPH assay for ACC deaminase activity, scaled down twentyfold onto a 96-well plate, with the calculations that turn an absorbance into an amount of product.
blocks.text: A microscale DNPH assay for ACC deaminase activity, scaled down twentyfold onto a 96-well plate, with the calculations that turn an absorbance into an amount of product.

blocks.en: A protein gel reports how much enzyme is present, not whether it is active. ACC deaminase cleaves ACC into α-ketobutyrate and ammonia, so either product can stand in for activity: the Berthelot assay reads the ammonium, the 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (DNPH) assay reads the α-ketobutyrate directly. The published comparison favors DNPH because the ACC substrate does not interfere, the background in complex culture media is lower, and it is reported as nineteen times more sensitive [8] – sensitive enough for initial velocities, and with them Km and kcat.

blocks.zh: 蛋白質膠告訴你有多少酵素，不告訴你它有沒有活性。ACC 去胺酶把 ACC 切成 α-酮丁酸與氨，所以兩種產物都能代表活性：Berthelot 法讀銨，2,4-二硝基苯肼（DNPH）法則直接讀 α-酮丁酸。已發表的比較偏向 DNPH，因為 ACC 受質不會干擾、在複雜培養基中的背景較低，而且據報靈敏度高十九倍 [8]——靈敏到足以量初速度，進而得到 Km 與 kcat。

blocks.en: What we changed. We scaled the conventional Penrose and Glick procedure down twentyfold, holding the original reaction proportions, so that it runs on a 96-well microplate instead of in tubes. The reaction is 110 µL – 100 µL of filtered culture supernatant, 5 µL of 20× reaction buffer and 5 µL of 1 M ACC – and each timepoint draws a 10 µL aliquot, quenched, cleared, derivatized with DNPH in 2 N HCl and developed with NaOH before reading at 540 nm. One plate replaces a tube per reading, which is what makes a time course or a panel of strains practical.

blocks.en: What we used it for. Alongside the procedure we established a standard curve against sodium 2-oxobutyrate and the arithmetic behind it: net absorbance against a sample blank, interpolation on that curve, and conversion into total product over the reaction volume.

blocks.en: Batch systems change throughout a run, so cell density and product concentration move together with no way to set one without moving the other. Researching bioreactors elsewhere, we never found a group using a hollow-fiber membrane to separate bacteria from a produced protein, so we built a continuous system that keeps the cells in the lumen and lets secreted protectant pass into the permeate.

blocks.en: In-line optical density photometer
blocks.text: In-line optical density photometer
blocks.zh: 線上光密度光度計

blocks.en: OD600 is conventionally read by pulling a grab sample into a benchtop spectrophotometer, which is manual, infrequent and open to contamination. Ours reads inside the loop. A 600 nm source, a paralleling lens, a 90:10 beam splitter feeding a reference channel, two GY-302 lux sensors on one I²C bus and a 2 mm flow cuvette; it runs with no computer attached and reports OD600 from the sample-to-reference ratio about every ten minutes. Five build cycles took it from a bench light path to the instrument that ran for 400 hours, and a slimmer second design followed in October. The parts come to about US$360, against roughly US$15 000 for the benchtop instrument it stands in for.

blocks.zh: OD600 慣常的讀法是抽一管樣品放進檯面分光光度計，既費人工、頻率又低，還有污染風險。我們這台是在迴路裡讀。一個 600 nm 光源、一片準直透鏡、一個 90:10 分光鏡供應參考通道、同一條 I²C 匯流排上的兩顆 GY-302 照度感測器，以及一個 2 mm 的流通比色管；它不接電腦也能運作，並約每十分鐘由樣品對參考的比值回報 OD600。五輪建造循環把它從檯面上的一條光路，帶到連續運轉 400 小時的儀器，十月又跟上一個更輕巧的第二版設計。零件約 US$360，而它所取代的檯面儀器約為 US$15 000。

blocks.en: What it standardizes. Measurement in-line with no sample removed; a 16-reading burst with the first two discarded, then median and MAD; outliers rejected beyond median ± 3·MAD, with the rejection rate shown in red above 50%; two acceptance gates added in October, one flagging readings whose two estimates differ by more than 0.03 OD and one holding back a jump beyond 0.05 OD until three readings agree; fixed optical geometry; logging every 10 minutes.

blocks.en: Why it matters. Measuring in-line removes the handling step behind most of the variance in manual OD readings. Against a BioDrop the raw, uncorrected output agrees to a median of 3.8%, so the instrument can be rebuilt and used without fitting a calibration equation to a reference machine.

blocks.en: Light plate apparatus
blocks.text: Light plate apparatus
blocks.zh: 光照板裝置

blocks.en: The light dose a culture receives depends on LED output, distance, vessel geometry and crosstalk between neighboring wells, and existing light plate hardware was costly enough to be a barrier. Ours is a four-by-six holder of twenty-four cultures, lit at about 535 nm or about 670 nm, with an Arduino driving three MOSFET channels by PWM. Forty LEDs were measured one at a time and matched in fours, which brought each group within 0.4 to 1.8% of itself, from spreads of 26% in green and 22% in red before sorting.

blocks.zh: 一瓶培養液接受到的光劑量，取決於 LED 輸出、距離、容器幾何，以及相鄰孔位之間的串光，而既有的光照板硬體貴到足以成為門檻。我們這台是 4 × 6、可放二十四瓶培養液的管座，照明波長約 535 nm 或約 670 nm，由一塊 Arduino 以 PWM 驅動三個 MOSFET 通道。四十顆 LED 逐顆量測後四顆一組配對，使每組內部差異收斂到 0.4 至 1.8%，而分組前綠光的離散度為 26%、紅光為 22%。

blocks.en: Matching alone did not separate the tiers. Even after sorting, the groups sat too close together to form three distinct intensity tiers, so the tiers are set by the PWM duty cycle and the matching makes the four cultures in a group comparable to each other. The division of labor is what transfers: sort the LEDs for replicate consistency, set the dose in firmware. A ten-page assembly guide builds the array from the printed parts and the matched LEDs up, and the per-LED measurements are published with it on Hardware: LPA.

blocks.en: Interpreting large environmental datasets is still difficult for a non-specialist, so we wrote a broad, reusable prompt: a structural guideline an LLM follows to turn raw data with inconsistent coordinates, software and formatting into GeoJSON, CSV or shapefiles QGIS can read. Its rules: use only the data provided, never geocode or invent a coordinate, ask when the reference system is unknown, flag empty, ambiguous or unusable values, show the calculation, and state the reference system in the output. The LLM does not do the analysis; it organizes the data the user already has. The prompt text, a beginner’s QGIS guide and the thirteen maps behind this analysis are on Geospatial Analysis.

blocks.en: Why it matters. At least 1300 million tons of agricultural waste is produced every year. Handling it through landfill and incineration contributes about 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions and creates various toxic pollutants [5]; for hay in particular, humid weather in Taiwan damages its quality and encourages mold, wasting nearly 5000 tonnes each season [6]. Repurposing these wastes turns a local byproduct into a resource, and supports SDG 12. Preparation still takes processing, so deployment would more realistically run through farmer cooperatives or agricultural research stations than through individual farmers, which lifts the technical burden off the farmer but adds transport, processing and distribution costs.
